review.headline: Reps averaged about 4:00/km against a 3:55/km target, with controlled warm-up and cool-down.
observations: The 1.6 km rep block averaged 4:00/km against the 3:55/km target, about 5 s/km slow but close to plan.
Heart rate in the reps averaged 171 bpm with a 174 bpm peak, so the effort was close to maximal.
Recovery jogs averaged 6:20/km over 1.2 km, consistent with easy running and a proper recovery.
Warm-up and cool-down were both 2.0 km at 5:45/km with HR 135-142, which is controlled and easy.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so the session's perceived effort is unknown.
Week 3 volume is well below plan (15.8 km actual vs 43.4 km planned) and CTL has dropped 5.9 over 7 days, so fitness is slipping.
